themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that autonomously perform research tasks, from data collection to analysis and decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Research and discussion around AI-generated users or personas used for testing and simulation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI tools and techniques for condensing large amounts of text into concise summaries, like meeting notes or research papers.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Tools and platforms designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and discussions specifically on the use, impact, and research conducted using AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being applied to enhance or automate tasks within the design and user research lifecycle.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating or augmenting the process of testing product usability.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to analyze and extract sentiment from user feedback, reviews, and social media.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Articles discussing the application of AI in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing interviews or open-ended responses.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
